messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #82: "[P1][feature] Create SDK compliance test suite (parameterized per channel)"

## Issue Details
No contract tests exist to verify channels comply with the SDK. When the SDK adds a utility or changes a pattern, channels silently drift. The audit found 14 inconsistencies across 4 channels.

### What to Test (parameterized across telegram, discord, whatsapp, slack)
- Required: Extends BaseChannelPlugin, implements connect/disconnect/sendMessage, uses emit methods, error class extends core ChannelError
- Reliability: createInboundDedupeCache, createDownloadGuard, sanitizeMessage
- Optional capabilities: canStreamResponse→createStreamSender, canFetchHistory→fetchHistory types, journey timing T2/T10/T11
- Test location: packages/channel-sdk/src/__tests__/compliance.test.ts

### Blocked by
- #81 (ChannelError migration)
- #85 (emit method consolidation)
- #86 (sendTyping standardization)

### Acceptance Criteria
- Test suite in packages/channel-sdk/src/__tests__/compliance.test.ts
- Runs against all 4 channels
- CI integration (make test includes it)
- Documents what compliance means
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
